tasks.title: Design authentication flow for Supabase
tasks.description:
Create the auth flow supporting email/password and GitHub OAuth. Include sign-up, sign-in, and password reset screens.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Email/password auth works
- [ ] GitHub OAuth redirects correctly
- [ ] Password reset sends email

tasks.title: Set up Supabase project and schema
tasks.description:
Initialize Supabase project. Create tables: organizations, users, projects, boards, tasks, documents, sprints, comments, attachments.

See PRD v4 for full schema.

tasks.title: Build kanban board webview
tasks.description:
Implement the main kanban board as a VS Code webview panel. Must support:
- 5 default columns (configurable)
- Drag-and-drop between columns
- Task card rendering with title, assignee avatar, priority badge
- Filter bar (assignee, priority, label)

tasks.title: Implement task detail view
tasks.description:
When a user clicks a task card, open a full detail view in an editor tab. Includes:
- Title (editable)
- Markdown description with preview
- Assignee picker
- Priority selector
- Labels
- Linked documents
- Comment thread
- Activity log

tasks.title: Create sidebar tree views (My Tasks, Documents, Sprints)
tasks.description:
Register three tree view providers in the PRendgame activity bar:
1. My Tasks — grouped by status, shows badge count
2. Documents — grouped by type (PRD, Spec, etc.)
3. Sprints — current + upcoming, with task counts

tasks.title: Build document editor webview with PRD template
tasks.description: Create a markdown editor webview with live preview. Pre-fill with PRD template (Overview, Goals, User Stories, Requirements, Non-Goals, Open Questions). Support mermaid diagram rendering.

tasks.title: Implement list view for tasks
tasks.description: Add a table/list view as an alternative to kanban. Sortable columns: ID, title, status, assignee, priority, sprint. Toggle between kanban/list/timeline via tabs.

tasks.title: Implement timeline view
tasks.description: Add a horizontal timeline (Gantt-lite) view showing tasks laid out by sprint/week. Swimlanes by assignee.

tasks.title: Expose MCP server tools for external agents
tasks.description:
Implement a local MCP server within the extension that exposes:
- prendgame.tasks.list / get / create / update / transition
- prendgame.docs.list / get
- prendgame.sprint.current / my_tasks
- prendgame.board.snapshot

tasks.title: Build MCP activity log panel
tasks.description: Read-only panel that shows a live feed of MCP tool calls from external agents. Each entry shows: timestamp, agent name, tool called, parameters, result summary.

tasks.title: Add mock cloud sync indicator
tasks.description: Status bar item showing sync state: synced (green check), syncing (spinner), offline (gray). For the mock, always show 'synced'.

tasks.title: Add mock team presence avatars
tasks.description: Show avatar circles on the board header for team members who are 'online'. Pull from mock team data. Show status dot (green/yellow/gray).

tasks.title: Write PRD for notification system
tasks.description: Draft a PRD for in-IDE notifications: task assignments, status changes, @mentions in comments, sprint start/end alerts.

tasks.title: Implement mock paywall modal for cloud sync
tasks.description: When a free-tier user clicks 'Enable Cloud Sync', show a modal explaining the Team plan: features, pricing placeholder, CTA button.

tasks.title: Sprint dashboard view
tasks.description: Webview showing current sprint overview: progress bar, task breakdown by status, team workload chart, blockers list, sprint goal.

tasks.title: QA pass on kanban board interactions
tasks.description: Test drag-and-drop across all columns, filter combinations, card rendering edge cases (long titles, no assignee, multiple labels).
